behavior: Forward each original HLE call exactly once with the same PPC context and guest memory; no wait removal
host_tests: ASan/UBSan passed with diagnostics ON and OFF: forwarding, context changes, timing units, reset and startup discard
linked_guest_import_mapping: all seven entries verified to reference corresponding diagnostic wrappers

findings: High-frequency delays and object waits account for much of the swapping thread wall interval. Source inspection found a guest/host priority-scale mismatch in zero-duration Delay. Its contribution requires a corrected-build console comparison.
